settings.intro: Located at our production facility in Carol Stream, just 25 minutes from Chicago. Our store offers a wide variety of Grunt Style products, along with a view to the production floor.  Don't see what you want in our store?  Don't worry, we can order from our warehouse and have it for you in 20 minutes!
